places.name: One East Broad
places.summary: One East Broad is a five-story building constructed in 2007 at 1 East Broad Street, marking modern development within downtown Bethlehem.
facts: Its presence illustrates recent urban growth on East Broad Street.

places.name: The Sun Inn
places.summary: The Sun Inn is a historic building constructed in 1758 on Main Street and played a significant role as a social and diplomatic hub in Bethlehem's colonial era.
facts: Built in 1758, making it one of the oldest buildings in the area.
Known historically for hosting prominent figures and events during colonial America.

places.name: Historic Bethlehem
places.summary: The Historic Bethlehem district is a National Historic Landmark complex featuring some of the oldest surviving Moravian buildings in the U.S., recognized worldwide for its communal religious heritage and recently designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
facts: Encompasses a 14.7-acre area containing early Moravian buildings.
Designated as a National Historic Landmark District in 2012.
Named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2024 alongside other Moravian settlements globally.

places.name: Moravian University
places.summary: Moravian University traces its origins to the 1742 Moravian girls' school and evolved through merging with boys' schools, becoming a university in 2021 that reflects a heritage dating back to early religious educational efforts in Bethlehem.
facts: Founded originally as girls' and boys' schools by Moravians in the 1740s.
Combined into Moravian College in 1954 and became a university in 2021.
Its roots connect directly to Moravian educational and religious traditions.
